about: The recorded descriptions `lune run kit sfx clap eval` scores the sound search on (2026-11-08). `want`: a pattern the library id of a RIGHT sound matches - a proxy (the sound's name, not the ear), so listen before trusting a pick. The eval sorts each description itself: `shared` when the plain word search finds any sound for it, `unshared` when it finds none (only CLAP can answer). Only sounds whose file is still there count. A description that missed in real use belongs here.
